dedupe_keys.name: transportapi uk multimodal public transport data apis journey planning bus and rail information and performance

description: TransportAPI is a UK managed services provider for public transport data. It aggregates open data sources, works with vendors on data quality and blends in proprietary sources, and says it powers over 25 percent of UK transport operator apps by operator market share, with more than 10,000 registered developers over more than ten years. Coverage: nationwide UK public transport across bus, rail, tube, metro and tram; the managed services are a journey planner with several planning engines, bus information (departure boards, buses on a map, journey details, route geometry, scheduled and real-time data), bus performance (journey lateness, punctuality and reliability, leg traversal times with time, weekly pattern and spatial filters), rail information (departure boards and journeys, scheduled and real time), rail performance (historical lateness, schedule changes, cancellations and reliability) and places (stops, stations and points of interest). Format and access: REST APIs authenticated with an app ID and key through the developer portal, with documentation and examples; a free plan of 30 requests a day and paid plans with higher allowances and service level agreements. Licence: the company states no downstream intellectual property retention and that customers may use the data as they see fit; the full terms were not read. Caveats: much of the data derives from UK open data feeds that can also be used directly; paid plan prices were not read. Simulation uses: schedules, real-time positions and historical punctuality for public transit network flow, service performance and disruption models. Related records: the Bus Open Data Service (data-uk-bus-open-data-service), NaPTAN stops (data-uk-naptan) and the TransXChange standard (data-uk-transxchange-bus-schedule-xml-standard).
